risk_note: RV2 state-machine task (specs/state-machines, packages/domain): adds specs/state-machines/export-task.yaml for the admin export task (CT-24k contract): states pending / running / done / failed / expired / cancelled, equal to the export_status enum; edges START pending→running, COMPLETE running→done, FAIL running→failed, EXPIRE done→expired, CANCEL pending / running→cancelled, RETRY failed→pending; expired and cancelled are terminal. packages/domain/src/state-machines/export-task.gen.ts is generated by the shared generator (not hand-edited); the domain package entry exports EXPORT_TASK_STATES / EVENTS / TRANSITIONS, transitionExportTask and the four types from the generated file, and the hand-written NotImplemented shell is removed. Illegal moves return {ok:false, reason:'illegal', id:null} like every generated machine. Rule tests (90, [AC-B1-34g#n]) written by Codex, red before the implementation, green after; implementation by an Opus 5.5 subagent in one run.
